title: Construction of the cocycle Leray edge
statement: For a morphism f:X to Y of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let H^q and R^q f_* be the module cohomology and higher direct image functors [pqf-def-cohomology] of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. There exists a family of natural homomorphisms from H^q(X,-) to global sections of R^q f_* satisfying the injective-resolution cocycle equation in the Lean signature: after identifying sections of the direct image [def-pc-module-pullback] with sections on X, each global cycle lifts to a section of the cycle sheaf and its edge value is its projected homology class, for every injective resolution [def-sp-injective-resolutions].

proof.text: Choose in each degree the natural section-complex comparison tau supplied by lem-pc-leray-complex-cocycle-comparison. For each module F, conjugate its component on the chosen injective resolution by the two isoRightDerivedObj comparisons: the sections comparison hom on the source and the direct-image comparison inv on the target, after forgetting the section-ring scalar actions. This defines the components of epsilon.

For a coefficient morphism a:F to Fprime, choose InjectiveResolution.desc a between the chosen resolutions. The hom-naturality of isoRightDerivedObj for sections and inv-naturality for direct image identify the two resolution comparisons with the homology maps of this descent. Naturality of tau makes the middle square commute; associativity gives the naturality equation for epsilon.

For any other injective resolution I of F, descend the identity of F from I to the chosen resolution. The same two inverse comparison naturality equations and naturality of tau give (I.sectionsComparison).inv followed by epsilon = tau_I followed by sections of (I.directImageComparison).inv; cancel the adjacent chosen sections comparison inv and hom. Evaluate this identity on the homology class of s. The complex-comparison cocycle equation supplies z and its homology image; apply sections of the inverse direct-image comparison to that equation. Finally eliminate K by hK, so the displayed eqToHom chain maps are identities. This yields both equations in LerayEdgeCocycle for arbitrary I and K.
